name: Abby Luten
source:
The principal of Tina Koya High School. [url=https://vndb.org/c174069]John[/url] hasn't met with her very often. An older woman who has dedicated a lot to her career, she spends much of her time worrying over running the school. She suffers from a number of health issues, including chronic migraines. She would do anything to escape that, even steal another person's body.

[In game description]
